qrList.label: New Character
qrList.title: Create a fresh level-1 character sheet for this chat (auto-runs on a new chat).
qrList.message:
/getvar key=initialized |
/if left={{pipe}} right=true rule=eq
  else={:
    /setvar key=maxhp 20 |
    /setvar key=hp 20 |
    /setvar key=ac 14 |
    /setvar key=level 1 |
    /setvar key=xp 0 |
    /setvar key=prof 2 |
    /setvar key=gold 50 |
    /setvar key=str 2 |
    /setvar key=dex 3 |
    /setvar key=con 2 |
    /setvar key=int 0 |
    /setvar key=wis 1 |
    /setvar key=cha 1 |
    /setvar key=conditions none |
    /setvar key=initialized true |
    /echo severity=success New adventurer ready — HP 20/20, AC 14, Level 1, 50 gold.
  :}
  {: /comment Character sheet already exists for this chat. :}

qrList.label: Show Sheet
qrList.title: Display the current character sheet.
qrList.message: /echo severity=info HP {{getvar::hp}}/{{getvar::maxhp}} — AC {{getvar::ac}} — Lvl {{getvar::level}} (XP {{getvar::xp}}) — Gold {{getvar::gold}} — STR+{{getvar::str}} DEX+{{getvar::dex}} CON+{{getvar::con}} INT+{{getvar::int}} WIS+{{getvar::wis}} CHA+{{getvar::cha}} — Conditions: {{getvar::conditions}}

qrList.label: Roll
qrList.title: Roll an arbitrary dice formula (droll syntax, e.g. 1d20+3).

qrList.label: Attack
qrList.title: Roll d20 + STR against a target AC.
qrList.message:
/input default=15 Target Armor Class (AC): |
/setvar key=_tac {{pipe}} |
/setvar key=_d20 {{roll::1d20}} |
/add {{getvar::_d20}} {{getvar::str}} |
/setvar key=_atk {{pipe}} |
/if left={{getvar::_atk}} right={{getvar::_tac}} rule=gte
  else={: /echo severity=warning MISS — {{getvar::_atk}} (d20 {{getvar::_d20}} + STR {{getvar::str}}) vs AC {{getvar::_tac}}. :}
  {: /echo severity=success HIT — {{getvar::_atk}} (d20 {{getvar::_d20}} + STR {{getvar::str}}) vs AC {{getvar::_tac}}. :}

qrList.label: Take Damage
qrList.title: Subtract damage from HP. Accepts a number (7) or a formula (2d6+1).

qrList.label: Heal
qrList.title: Restore HP (capped at max). Accepts a number or a formula.
qrList.message:
/input default=1d8 Healing (number or formula): |
/setvar key=_hf {{pipe}} |
/if left={{getvar::_hf}} right=d rule=in
  else={: /setvar key=_heal {{getvar::_hf}} :}
  {: /setvar key=_heal {{roll::{{getvar::_hf}}}} :} |
/add {{getvar::hp}} {{getvar::_heal}} |
/setvar key=hp {{pipe}} |
/if left={{getvar::hp}} right={{getvar::maxhp}} rule=gt {: /setvar key=hp {{getvar::maxhp}} :} |
/if left={{getvar::hp}} right=0 rule=gt {: /setvar key=conditions none :} |
/echo severity=success Healed {{getvar::_heal}}. HP {{getvar::hp}}/{{getvar::maxhp}}.

qrList.label: Inject State
qrList.title: Hidden: injects the authoritative character state into the prompt before every generation.
qrList.message:
/getvar key=initialized |
/if left={{pipe}} right=true rule=eq {:
  /inject id=charsheet position=chat depth=2 role=system Player character state (authoritative — the narrator must never invent or contradict these): HP {{getvar::hp}}/{{getvar::maxhp}}, AC {{getvar::ac}}, Level {{getvar::level}}, Conditions: {{getvar::conditions}}.
:}
